notes.content:

[h1]The latest The Silent Swan update is now available![/h1]

This update fixes the following minor bugs:

[list]
[*]An optional cursor has been added in the center of the screen for people with vision problems or motion sickness.
[*]Fix some hints were not updating when completed.
[*]Fix jump height achievement could not be get sometimes.

[/list]

notes.title: The Silent Swan - 1.2 update patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/b2c8ef26a9303ec6928e1d44ca50247a7edaae02.png[/img]

[h1]The latest The Silent Swan update is now available![/h1]

This update mainly [b]fixes the recurrent low texture quality[/b] throughout the game alongside the following minor bug fixes:

[list]
[*] “The Belltower” achievement can now be obtained, requiring to ring the bell atop the belltower.
[*] “Lost in the Woods” achievement has been fixed, requiring to reach the Verdurant Lair (Shaman’s lair).
[*] “The Last Road” achievement has been fixed, requiring to walk through the gates of the Unseen Complex.
[*] “The Bells of Kavrazyma” achievement has been fixed, requiring to interact with 10 different bells.
[*] Notebook is now disabled during the opening sequence.
[*]Corrected low quality textures.
[*]City props added.
[*]Corrected sounds.
[*]Programming changes of some achievements, now they are easier to get.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1898880/The_Silent_Swan/

notes.title: Devlog #4 - The Silent Swan
notes.content:
Today in devlog #4 we will talk about another of the pillars of development: programming.

On this occasion we introduce you to David Tabernero, Programmer at Praenaris. David is mainly in charge of creating all the systems and mechanics that we will enjoy in [i]The Silent Swan[/i], working together with the whole Praenaris team.
Among his tasks are:

[list]
[*] [b]Creation of new mechanics[/b]: David is in charge, through code, of shaping the mechanics that make up the videogame. These mechanics are previously specified from the design team which explains to David how they want the player to interact with the different elements of the scenario so that David can recreate it in the most faithful way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/6399aa822ce803c9a4868efbd7524f058df45e51.png[/img]

[*] [b]UI and Game Feel[/b]: On the other hand David is also in charge of building all the interface systems that we will see throughout the video game, from the pause and start menus, as all the indicators and icons that we will see throughout the extensive world of [i]The Silent Swan[/i]. This task would not be complete without adding the "Game Feel", it is all those little details that help the player to have a more satisfying gaming experience, details such as the transition between the audio of the different areas of the game, the vibration of the controller at certain times and the different camera turns help the player to have a much more immersive experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/798e5d910255239a381f2f7ca3b9d2b3f82bcc14.png[/img]

[/list]
In addition to meeting David, in this post we leave you his social media so you can get to know David better and see first hand all the love we are putting in each section of [i]The Silent Swan[/i].

A hug sailors!

Praeneris Crew

You can follow David on social media:

[url=https://twitter.com/davidtabernerom]David's Twitter[/url]
[url=https://mastodon.online/@davidtabernerom]David's Mastodon[/url]
[url=https://es.linkedin.com/in/davidtabernerom]David's LinkedIn[/url]
[url=https://davidtabernero.net/]David's website[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/8a48d803d1a90a7b9c7a40fda4e3e623394e9e55.png[/img]

notes.title: The Silent Update: 0.8.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016253/1a1c1fbf5e9be1bb901fcd724b9b3ebcbecc7755.png[/img]

We are ecstatic about the incredible amount of feedback we have been receiving lately, and we would like to thank you all for it.

As promised, we continue to work hard to improve the game.

As such, here is the first batch of changes and corrections. This is the changelog:

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Quicycles cannot be interacted with
[*]Tree and vegetation popping
[*]Hanan elevator has no sound
[*]In road parkour it is not possible to go back up easily due to collision errors
[*]Neuron Box door cannot be opened (partial fix, still researching for bugs)
[*]Some postprocessing not working as intended
[*]Transition fading with Selene sometimes do not trigger when it should
[*]Some minor fixes
[/list]

[h1]Improved[/h1]
[list]
[*]Player now jumps slightly higher
[/list]

[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gamepad control for jump rebinded from A (XBOX) / X (PS) to B (XBOX) / O (PS)
[/list]

That is all for now, we keep working, see you Beyond the Walls!
